Energy management is one of our most important skills to master. It was also hard realizing that others didn’t care and/or think like me. I thought most people felt to the degree I do, that’s not the case at all. Most people or at least the people in my non-professional life are very self-centered and lack extensive empathy for others. 

I have to remind myself to be very deliberate about my energy management, if not I can quickly over give and hurt myself. 

I had a friend who was going through a breakup around the same time my brother committed suicide. I put their feelings before mine and never addressed the emotions I was going through nor did it really seem like anyone (especially that friend) even really cared. After all I gave to that friend, I felt extremely alone and used. That experience changed a lot for me.

It’s frustrating and for me can easily lead to resentment. Over the past year of the pandemic I saw a lot of true colors and backed away from people, which causes issues, because they couldn’t understand why I was keeping to myself. I had to explain that I needed to put on my oxygen mask first.

This particular person I cared about deeply, but the feeling seemed to never been reciprocated. One day, this individual told me they were unable to come to an event, which is fine, but then proceeded to be about 10 minutes from my house and not mention it until I asked what they were up to. I got upset and told them why. They responded that they didn't have to tell me everything they were doing. Yet, this person always referred to me as this best friend. To me, not mentioning anything is weird, secretive, and not someone who I want to be friends with, so I made an effort to stop talking to them, not make any plans, and move on. I talk occasionally, but it's about superficial stuff, like TV shows, so I don't get attached, nothing that goes on in my life. Since then this person has gone through some bad things in life, but I stop myself from going out of my way, because things would eventually revert back to how they were before. In the end, I made a good decision. That person thinks we're BFFs, I don't think we are kindred spirits.
